ideas.pitch: An interactive browser extension and web toolkit designed to instantly inspect, manipulate, and decode steganographic layers, audio spectrograms, and custom ciphers for ARG puzzles.
ideas.problem_statement: CTF CICADA 2026: ARG-style experience featuring 30 progressive levels involving images, ciphers, websites, and hidden information.
ideas.title: StegoWeb: Browser-Based Steganography & Cipher Toolkit for ARGs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core mechanics of an ARG-style CTF means judges evaluating the progressive puzzle flow will immediately appreciate a tool that streamlines complex digital investigation and cipher decoding.

ideas.pitch: A unified dashboard that rapidly tests text and file inputs against dozens of classical ciphers, frequency analyses, and encoding formats to accelerate puzzle solving.
ideas.problem_statement: CTF CICADA 2026: Cryptic clues, hidden messages, ciphers, and challenging puzzles across 30 progressive levels.
ideas.title: CipherForge: Automated Multi-Layer Cryptanalysis Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: By leaning into genuine hard engineering for automated cryptographic decoding, this tool directly aids teams racing through progressive levels under time pressure.

ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative workspace built specifically for small teams to map out web elements, drop image clues, link cipher dependencies, and track solved levels.
ideas.problem_statement: CTF CICADA 2026: Progressive puzzle-solving journey with teams of 1-3 members navigating 30 levels of trails and clues.
ideas.title: ArgTrail: Collaborative Clue Mapping & Timeline Workspace for CTF Teams
ideas.why_it_could_win: Designed specifically for teams of 1-3 members where coordination speed across multi-stage digital investigations determines victory.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web tool specialized in generating audio spectrograms, isolating hidden audio frequencies, and performing LSB pixel analysis on suspicious images.
ideas.problem_statement: CTF CICADA 2026: Explore clues involving images, ciphers, websites, and hidden information in an ARG-inspired format.
ideas.title: SpectroCrypt: Audio & Visual Artifact Extractor for Hidden Clues
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a technically difficult, highly repetitive task in media-heavy ARGs with exceptional polish and a working live demo.

ideas.pitch: A secure client-side encrypted vault for storing sensitive puzzle tokens, API keys, credentials, and decrypted fragments discovered during long-duration online competitions.
ideas.problem_statement: CTF CICADA 2026: Fully online competition lasting a month (10 December 2026 – 10 January 2027) requiring secure persistence of multi-stage progress.
ideas.title: VaultNotes: Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Clue Locker for CTF Competitions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines military-grade privacy patterns with practical competition longevity, mirroring proven security app winners.
